text: SUPERVISOR — addendum on the hint-line suspect, from the user: "ok but those dont change. im not moving. they dont update." Correct — the TEXT is static. So the only mechanisms left are: (1) IDENTITY LOSS — the heartbeat re-render recreates the subtree (flipping key, conditional mount, unstable parent), same chars but new node instances -> re-capture -> repaint; (2) FRACTIONAL SIZE JITTER — supporting evidence in the logs: atlas_glyph_count climbs monotonically (388->400->557->559) while screen text is static, i.e. the SAME characters keep entering the atlas as NEW size buckets — a layout-derived font size recomputing to 13.9999 vs 14.0001 per remount. Check: the hint component's key/conditional identity across the heartbeat, and whether its font size is computed from layout floats instead of a constant. And find what ticks every ~0.4s re-rendering the play HUD at all. Content-diffing is a dead end — diff IDENTITY and SIZE KEYS.
resolution: Resolved in b91a941962eeb56e3cbc631f1ac39f2ce59f10d7. Added identity/size-key focused tracing: React churn records component identity changes, text traces include requested and rendered font-size buckets, and stale recovered-frame deltas are no longer misattributed to the spike.
